title: Tunnels between buildings.
officialText:
Tunnels connecting buildings and projecting beyond street lines may be constructed subject
to the approval of the Commissioner of the Department of Transportation. Such tunnels shall comply with the provisions of this
code and other applicable laws and regulations.
